tools.name: mcp_resource
tools.description: Find documentation, skills and workflows. Without uri, query filters the resource index (e.g. 'skills' or a task). With uri, query searches passages ('*' lists headings), section reads matching headings; omit both for full text. User skills include a revision for updates with wangp_io(action='save_skill'). limit caps results/text blocks per page; cursor continues unchanged filters. Follow next_call for more.

tools.name: wangp_models
tools.description: Find models by name (query alone), or discover search filters, speciality matching and speed/size preferences. Search specialities directly (plurals and aliases already match); action='specialities', arguments={} lists declared strengths only if a search finds nothing. action='lookup', arguments={'query': ...} only names models (model_type, name, output).

tools.name: wangp_model
tools.description: Explore a chosen model's capabilities, limits, definition, defaults, accelerator profiles, presets, user settings and LoRAs.

tools.name: wangp_templates
tools.description: Browse reusable generation recipes shared with Deepy. No arguments lists tasks and their configured defaults; task alone lists compact templates; task + template returns full resolved settings. Use template='default' to read the configured default directly without browsing. Browse rows include model specialities and supported media_inputs, not mandatory inputs: read model input/prompt guidance for the selected modes. Returned settings already include active general_properties; apply explicit user overrides last. Follow next_call to continue a template list. Sound effects have no task: find their models with wangp_models (specialities such as 'sound effects').

task.description: gen_image: Create images from text; edit_image: Edit images using reference images; gen_video: Generate video from a prompt, including dialogue with audio-capable models; gen_video_with_speech: Generate video driven by an existing speech clip; gen_video_with_refs: Generate video conditioned on reference images or videos for subjects, appearance or motion; supported media depend on the template; gen_song: Generate music or songs; gen_speech_from_description: Generate speech using a text-described voice; gen_speech_from_sample: Generate speech using a voice sample; gen_world: Generate an explorable world (Worlds gallery) from a world description (with its first view in image_start for templates whose input_modes include image_prompt_type S), optionally walked through with exploration instructions after it, or continue a world given as custom_guide; world_output chooses world, world_video or video. Also shows a picture from another viewpoint (a step aside, a turn, walking in): a template taking image_start, the move as instructions, world_output video, then a frame of that video; gen_3d: Create a 3D asset for the 3D gallery. Qwen3.5 GLB 3D Coder takes a text description directly and can export animated parts. Image-to-3D templates take one picture in image_refs. If the chosen template needs a picture, a gen_image template can make one: one whole object, centered on a plain background, seen three-quarters from slightly above, in soft even light. The templates are the main recipes (a shape, an optional 3D Refiner, a Texturer): the default suits most objects, keeps thin parts and copies the picture's colours and print; SUPRA-Tex Pixal3D builds the mesh in the picture's own camera (the closest fit to the picture); Hunyuan3D 2.1 PBR paints all around and tolerates unusual pictures; Solid Objects adds fine relief to solid parts (thin sheets such as leaves keep the plain shape). Other 3D models (untextured shapes, parts, Gaussian splats, mesh refinement, segmentation, animation, scene reconstruction) are found with wangp_models and used with their defaults; texture_3d: Texture a mesh of the 3D gallery given as custom_guide from one picture of the same object in image_refs, showing it from the front or three quarters, not steeply from above (PBR textures keeping the picture's colours; to restyle a mesh, edit the picture it was made from); the Hunyuan3D 2.1 Paint template tolerates a picture that differs from the mesh; a template may refine the mesh first; swap_video: Replace people or characters in an existing video (video_guide); read the template's input guidance first; edit_video: Change objects, setting, weather, light or style in an existing video (video_guide); read the template's input guidance first

template.description: A returned template name, or default for the configured default. Omit to browse without full settings.

tools.name: wangp_python
tools.description: Run Python (numpy, PIL, SVG, matplotlib, data and text) in a persistent sandbox: compute layouts and timings, draw and compose images, build clips frame by frame; files saved under out/ join the Gallery.

tools.name: wangp_list_gallery
tools.description: List current and remembered Gallery images, videos, audio, 3D assets and worlds. selected_only=true returns only the media the user selected in the gallery WanGP shows (with the video playhead time); media_type filters by kind. Results alternate image/video, audio, 3D and Worlds, newest-first within each gallery. A world is explored by the user in the Worlds gallery; its video is in the image/video gallery and IO info on its media_id lists its segments. Returned media_id values identify inputs to other tools. Pages have count/volume limits. Continue with unchanged filters and cursor=next_cursor; cursors expire after 10 minutes or eviction. summary_only returns the stored count without items. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

agent_context.description: Context returned by wangp_workspace; reuse after reconnecting or for separate logical agents.

tools.name: wangp_toolbox
tools.description: Inspect or compare media, transcribe, extract, trim, assemble, resize or crop media, or retrieve their generation settings. wait=false runs a slow action (transcription, 3D views, masks) in the background and returns a job_id for wangp_session get_job / wait_jobs. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

tools.name: wangp_validate
tools.description: CPU-only preflight without submitting, downloading or loading models. Supply settings (one generation or batch), OR media + process + parameters for a processor. Summary returns requested size/duration, grid-adjusted canvas and initial dimensions for simple inputs, the window_plan of sliding-window videos (each window's generated_seconds), adjustments, inputs, diagnostics, availability and queue counts. Initial dimensions precede optional upscaling; complex input sizing is marked unresolved. Requested values are not predictions of final output geometry or cumulative duration. detail='full' only adds every effective setting and its origin (about 10 KB per task). valid does not guarantee runtime memory or model-specific inference checks. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

agent_context.description: Context returned by wangp_workspace; reuse after reconnecting or for separate logical agents.

tools.name: wangp_generate
tools.description: Generate image, video, audio or 3D assets. settings is one flat WanGP settings object, or a list of them for a batch submitted together in order. Each object needs model_type and the complete prompt; other WanGP settings go beside them, only custom_settings and the post-processing slots' spatial/temporal_postprocessing_parameters hold nested values, and media go directly in fields such as image_start or audio_guide. Template and media settings can be copied and edited. edit_* post-processing tasks need no model or prompt. A prompt may be @file("@documents/prompt.txt"): WanGP reads and snapshots that authorized UTF-8 file, preserving blank lines. Omitted resolution, video_length or duration_seconds, and seed use Deepy's standing defaults (world models keep their own resolution and length) before model factory settings; supplied values are preserved. wait=true waits for completion; timeout_s bounds waiting without cancelling the job. wait=false returns a job for asynchronous tracking. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

template.description: Optional template to start from: "<task>" (such as "gen_video") for its configured default, or "<task>/<template name>". WanGP fills in its settings except its example prompt and alt_prompt; give only the keys you change.

model_type.description: WanGP model type (from the template when one is named).

request_id.description: Optional retry key: the same key and payload returns the original job, even after a restart; a different payload is rejected.

Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

tools.name: wangp_plugins
tools.description: Workflows added by enabled WanGP plugins, one toolbox per plugin. Omit plugin to list them; plugin alone lists its actions with their call signatures; action with arguments=null reads its contract; action with arguments={...} runs it. Plugins: media_flow: Restore (deblur, decompress, ungrade, SDR to HDR, add detail), outpaint, upscale or interpolate existing videos and images with ready-made templates, one file or whole folders: long videos are processed in chunks with low RAM and the original audio is kept; stopped runs resume.; showrunner: Showrunner productions (music videos, films, ads, stories): read the production document, plan shots, render and judge takes, assemble the edit. wait=false runs an action in the background and returns a job_id for wangp_session get_job / wait_jobs / cancel_job. Optional agent_context resumes an assigned workspace; obtain it with wangp_workspace. Shared-user workspace and queue permissions apply.

agent_context.description: Context returned by wangp_workspace; reuse after reconnecting or for separate logical agents.

tools.name: wangp_workspace
tools.description: Agent workspaces: current returns/resumes your assignment; list queries the workspaces you may use (your own, and the user's unless the user restricted it); create starts an independent context (storage_mode: dedicated keeps its media in its own folder, shared in the common output folders; the configured default otherwise); attach creates a context for an existing workspace_id. Pass the returned agent_context on media, IO, job and session calls, especially after reconnecting or when multiplexing agents. Current shared-user permissions permit discovery/attachment; per-user visibility and cancellation rights are not implemented.
